name: Democratic Party
description: Follow Democratic Party, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Wisconsin's Democratic showdown and more primary races to watch today
changes.summary: South Carolina Republicans will be choosing a successor for the late Sen. Lindsey Graham's seat, and Minnesota's Senate primary is another battle between moderate and progressive Democrats.

changes.title: Primaries test the Democratic Party and ‘red alert’ after Colombia earthquake: Morning Rundown
changes.summary: Progressive Democrats fight for primary wins in Wisconsin and Minnesota.

changes.title: All Eyes on Key Midterm Primaries in Wisconsin and Minnesota
changes.summary: Voters are heading to the polls in another round of competitive primary races in the build-up to November’s midterm elections. In Wisconsin and Minnesota, Democrats will once again decide between moderate and progressive candidates. Meanwhile, in South Carolina, Republicans will pick a replacement nominee for the late.

changes.title: How We’re Covering an ‘Identity Crisis’ in Politics
changes.summary: Recent primary wins have posed critical questions for both Republicans and Democrats as they head into the fall midterms. Carolyn Ryan, managing editor of The New York Times, shares how reporters approach coverage of shifting political dynamics.

changes.title: Democrats Plan New Push to Defeat Max Miller in Ohio After Abuse Accusations
changes.summary: The party’s congressional campaign arm added Mr. Miller’s opponent, Brian Poindexter, to its highly competitive “Red to Blue” list.

changes.title: Wisconsin’s Roller Coaster of a Democratic Primary Race for Governor Crashes to an End
changes.summary: Democrats appear likely to nominate a democratic socialist for governor. How did they get here?

changes.title: Trump announces staff secretary Will Scharf, who helped secure ballroom approval, will be his new White House counsel
changes.summary: Democrats have vowed to pursue investigations into Trump and his administration if they are successful in November.

changes.title: Congressional Democrats to investigate efforts to deport U.S. military members and their families
changes.summary: The Pentagon declined to comment, stating it would "reply directly to the authors of the letter.".

changes.title: The Campaign Tactics Helping Progressives Win Primaries Ahead of the 2026 Midterms
changes.summary: Progressives are being outspent and are receiving little support from the Democratic Party. Their tactics show a different way to succeed.

changes.title: Democratic Minnesota Senate candidate says her campaign is about ‘the many versus the money’
changes.summary: Internal divisions between progressive and moderate Democrats grow ahead of tomorrow’s closely watched primary for Minnesota’s Senate seat. Minnesota Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan (D) joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss her bid for U.S. Senate.
